# PosiJump Productions

> A Pittsburgh-based marketing practice for small businesses that want strategy with personality, run by the person who actually does the work. Founded by Chris Pirschel.

PosiJump Productions is a one-person marketing practice based in Pittsburgh, PA, serving small businesses, solopreneurs, and founders. The practice covers six service lines that are built to fit together: marketing consulting, content strategy, copywriting and editing, SEO, podcast production, and social media management. Websites and landing-page work are folded into the consulting and content strategy offerings rather than billed as a separate service.

Chris Pirschel is the founder, sole practitioner, and primary contact. He has nearly 15 years of marketing and content experience across small businesses, startups, in-house roles, and freelance work, with deep specialization in healthcare marketing (oncology nursing, behavior analysis, wellness certification), commercial real estate certification (WELL, SEAM), and small-business growth (youth fitness, IT services, coffee).

The practice is delivered remote-first from Pittsburgh and works with clients across the United States. There are no handoffs to junior staff: the person you hire is the person doing the work.

## Services

- [Marketing Consulting](https://posijump.com/#services): Strategy sessions that audit your site, channels, and messaging, then map where to put your next dollar.
- [Content Strategy](https://posijump.com/#services): Pillars, cadence, calendar, the pages on your site to hold it, and the follow-through to ship.
- [Copywriting and Editing](https://posijump.com/#services): Websites, landing pages, emails, scripts. Written tight, edited tighter.
- [SEO](https://posijump.com/#services): Technical fixes where they matter, content built around real search intent, sustainable rankings.
- [Podcast Production](https://posijump.com/#services): Concept to published feed. Hosting, booking, producing, editing, show notes, monetization.
- [Social Media Management](https://posijump.com/#services): Platform-aware, on-voice content built around what your audience actually shows up for.

## Case Studies

- [Sharper content, right-fit clients](https://posijump.com/case-studies/it-services-seo.html): SEO and content rebuild for an IT services provider serving healthcare and real estate clients. 14% month-over-month visitor growth, higher-intent leads.
- [A healthcare podcast past a million](https://posijump.com/case-studies/healthcare-podcast.html): Concept-to-1M+-downloads weekly podcast for an oncology nursing membership organization, with continuing-education and ad revenue integration.
- [A clinic that sounded like itself online](https://posijump.com/case-studies/aba-clinic-social.html): Social media strategy and execution for a clinician-owned behavior analysis clinic in Raleigh, NC. 754% reach growth, 333% engagement growth, 41% increase in monthly website views.
- [Local SEO for a local favorite](https://posijump.com/case-studies/gantry-kids-seo.html): Local SEO and content optimization for Gantry Kids & Teens, a youth fitness program in Long Island City. 107 pages optimized, 15% year-over-year views.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio archive](https://posijump.com/portfolio/): 30+ pieces across writing (LinkedIn, IWBI/WELL Certified, ONS Voice, CureToday, Oncology Nursing News, Medium, SEAM), websites (SEAM Certification, Certainly, IWBI WELL pages, Gantry Kids, ITSco), podcasts (The ONS Podcast), and ad campaigns (IWBI WELL Health-Safety Rating, Investing in Health Pays Back, WELL AP Credential).
